what: 1. Scientific Overview & Multiomics Experimental Design Coverage
title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny Studio for Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmarking
text: scSimEvalStudio (version 0.99.3) is the interactive graphical benchmarking studio companion to scSimEval (version 0.99.12). It operationalizes reference-based simulation benchmarking by comparing synthetic datasets against an empirical biological reference dataset across 56 curated quantitative evaluation measures organized into 8 canonical biological and computational categories. Supports 4 experimental designs on Bioconductor SingleCellExperiment S4 objects (and Seurat via Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment()): Unimodal scRNA-seq (44 measures across 7 categories), Unimodal scATAC-seq (38 measures across 6 categories), Paired Co-Assay Multiomics via altExp(sce, 'ATAC') (56 measures across 8 categories), and Unpaired Multiomics (56 measures across 8 categories).

title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny Studio for Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmarking
text: The 4-Stage scSimEval & scSimEvalStudio Benchmarking Architecture covers: (I) Distributional Properties (14 measures: 10 univariate 1D distances Wasserstein, KS, MAD, MAE, RMSE, Bhattacharyya, KDE_ISE, Runs_Statistic, NN_Mismatch, Between_Dataset_Silh_Global and 4 bivariate 2D distances Fasano_Franceschini_2D_KS, EMD_2D, NN_Mismatch_2D, Between_Dataset_Silh_2D_Global across 18 empirical properties: 7 cell-level, 7 feature-level, 4 bivariate pairs); (II) Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics (5 measures: midpoint_error, slope_error, r2_discrepancy, curve_rmse, excess_zero_weight_discrepancy); (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance (8 measures: MMD, Generative_Precision, Generative_Recall, silhouette_sim, cdi, neighborhood_purity, ari, nmi); (IV) Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics (5 measures: batch_silhouette, pcr_r2, cms, isi, cross_batch_F1); (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity (12 measures: 6 scRNA-seq DE + 6 scATAC-seq DA via replicate-aware pseudobulk edgeR-QLF: pval_dist_score, accuracy, precision, recall, f1_score, auc); (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment (5 measures: batch_asw, cell_type_asw, graph_connectivity, integration_ari, integration_nmi); (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology (5 measures via HVG-filtered dynverse: him, edge_flip, geodesic_correlation, F1_branches, wcor_features); and (VIII) Computational Scalability & Efficiency (2 hardware-normalized measures: core_seconds and memory_per_core_mib).

what: 3. Direction-Aware Mathematical Score Normalization & Hierarchical Aggregation
title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny Studio for Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmarking
text: scSimEvalStudio transforms every raw measurement (Score_Raw) through a two-stage direction-aware normalization pipeline (scSimEval::normalize_bubble_scores()): zero-targeted statistics take absolute divergence |x|, lower-is-better distance/error/cost metrics are inverted and min-max normalized onto [0, 1], and higher-is-better concordance metrics are scaled directly onto [0, 1] where 1.00 denotes optimal empirical reference concordance. Metrics are averaged into category means S_cat and combined into the unweighted Overall Composite Score S_overall.

what: 4. Overview of the 8 Interactive Modules in scSimEvalStudio
title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny Studio for Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmarking
text: The 8 interactive tabs in scSimEvalStudio are: (1) Home KPI dashboard; (2) Data Hub with 4 ingestion modes (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, Paired & Unpaired Multiomics, Upload Saved Results .rds/.csv), Oryza sativa Rice Bud and Glycine max Soybean Root empirical benchmarks, and 1-Click Standalone HPC/Workstation R Script Generator; (3) Comparative Bubble Matrix & Fidelity Leaderboard; (4) Visualizations with 8 diagnostic sub-panels (Evaluation Summary, Distribution QC, Metric Heatmap, Metric Plots, PCA Ordination anchored to Ideal Reference Anchor 1, MDS Metric Space, Cell Embeddings UMAP/t-SNE/PCA with ASW & ARI, Scalability Benchmark) and 25%-400% Step-Zoom & 600% Fullscreen Lightbox; (5) Benchmark Results & Export (.rds, .xlsx, .csv); (6) Help & Getting Started with Dynamic Multi-Core Scheduling Table; (7) Logs real-time WebSocket diagnostic terminal; and (8) Contact (Division of Agricultural Bioinformatics, ICAR-IASRI, New Delhi).

title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny Studio for Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmarking
text: Install scSimEval and scSimEvalStudio from Bioconductor via BiocManager::install() or from GitHub via remotes::install_github(), and launch the studio with launch_scSimEval_app().

what: 1. Scientific Motivation & Multiomics Experimental Design Coverage
title: Interactive Single-Cell & Multiomics Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio
text: scSimEvalStudio (v0.99.3) and scSimEval (v0.99.12) establish a reference-based benchmarking framework comparing simulated datasets against empirical biological references across 56 curated evaluation measures in 8 canonical categories. Integrates natively with Bioconductor SingleCellExperiment S4 containers, altExp(sce, 'ATAC'), SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce) cell_type and batch metadata, BiocParallel, Matrix dgCMatrix, edgeR pseudobulk quasi-likelihood testing, CDI, CellMixS, scater, scuttle, and Seurat::as.SingleCellExperiment().

title: Interactive Single-Cell & Multiomics Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio
text: Complete mathematical and biological breakdown of Categories I-VIII and all 56 evaluation measures: Category I Distributional Properties (14 measures across 18 properties: library_size, log_library_size, tmm_factor, zero_fraction_cell, detection_freq_cell, cell_cor, pca_dist, mean_expression, variance, scaled_variance, cv, zero_fraction_feature, dispersion, gene_cor, lib_vs_cellzero, mean_vs_sd, mean_vs_featzero, mean_vs_dispersion), Category II Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics (5 measures), Category III Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance (8 measures), Category IV Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics (5 measures), Category V Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity (12 measures: 6 scRNA-seq DE + 6 scATAC-seq DA via replicate-aware pseudobulk edgeR-QLF), Category VI Multiomics Integration & Alignment (5 measures), Category VII Trajectory & Lineage Topology (5 measures via HVG-filtered dynverse), and Category VIII Computational Scalability & Efficiency (2 hardware-normalized measures: core_seconds = T_elapsed * N_cores and memory_per_core_mib = M_peak / N_cores).

title: Interactive Single-Cell & Multiomics Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio
text: Two-stage direction-aware transformation via scSimEval::normalize_bubble_scores(): Stage 1 aligns zero-targeted statistics, lower-is-better distance/error/cost metrics, and higher-is-better concordance metrics onto [0, 1]. Stage 2 consolidates Category I property scores, computes category fidelity means S_cat, and aggregates the unweighted Overall Composite Score S_overall.

what: 4. Detailed Guide to All 8 Interactive Modules in scSimEvalStudio
title: Interactive Single-Cell & Multiomics Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio
text: Walkthrough of Module 1 (Home), Module 2 (Data Hub with 4 modes, Rice Bud & Soybean Root datasets, and 1-Click Standalone HPC R Script Generator), Module 3 (Comparative Bubble Matrix & Fidelity Leaderboard), Module 4 (Visualizations: Evaluation Summary, Distribution QC, Metric Heatmap, Metric Plots, PCA Ordination with Ideal Reference Anchor 1, MDS Metric Space, Cell Embeddings UMAP/t-SNE/PCA with ASW & ARI quality table, Scalability Benchmark), Module 5 (Benchmark Results & Export: .rds, .xlsx, .csv), Module 6 (Help & Getting Started with Dynamic Multi-Core Scheduling Table), Module 7 (Logs live WebSocket terminal), and Module 8 (Contact).

title: Interactive Single-Cell & Multiomics Simulation Benchmarking with scSimEvalStudio
text: Verify that the bundled Shiny application initializes cleanly with shiny::shinyAppDir() and inspect the bundled 6-simulator demonstration benchmark database (demo_benchmark_data.rds: scMultiSim, scDesign3, MOSim, scCross, scMoMtF, Matilda).
code: library(scSimEvalStudio) app_dir <- system.file("shiny", "scSimEvalApp", package = "scSimEvalStudio") app <- shiny::shinyAppDir(app_dir) demo_obj <- readRDS(file.path(app_dir, "data", "demo_benchmark_data.rds"))

what: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
text: Launches the companion Shiny web application bundled in scSimEvalStudio. Provides a graphical interface to upload SingleCellExperiment biological reference and simulated datasets (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, paired or unpaired multiomics), execute the 56-measure evaluation suite across 8 canonical categories, explore diagnostic figures interactively, and export publication-quality figures, standalone HPC R scripts, and Excel/PDF reports.
code: launch_scSimEval_app(port = NULL, host = "127.0.0.1", launch.browser = interactive(), maxRequestSize = 10 * 1024^3)
